notes.title: Tower Defense Sale Update!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

It's finally here, our first big update timed for our first discounted sale for Engineered to Purpose. Thank you for your patience - we hope you enjoy the changes that we're rolling out for the game. Here's a full breakdown of all of the changes:

Targeting Type Revamp
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43151476/b384c65f0046df114f7355e229530c1d4dc98168.png
-Targeting type is set on tower placement rather than changed in real-time
-World 2 balance has been updated to account for this change

Minelayer
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43151476/d8d54063c2627ba54d63701ba699d9a0be4d7346.gif
-New weapon component added to the game that fires mines that explode when enemies are within range

Saturation replaces Heuristics
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43151476/59a5c9ddd05a4b37026fd05485b0c0ca9151ae37.gif
-Saturation modifier added to Blaster towers, giving them a charge of percentage-based damage every few seconds
-Heuristics modifiers on existing towers will be replaced with Power modifiers

Tower Charge visuals
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43151476/0b1b9ba696233e04929350c94ee89ab92011c31d.gif
-Added clearer visualization for charging mechanics on towers when you select them
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43151476/e9727b8b36c35911bad8a0cd20ff258e55ec0efe.gif
-Added special visual logic for laser ramp and saturation

SFX Pass
-Added new SFX for various UI elements and in-game interactions

Bug Fixes
-Fixed issues with updating towers
-Adjusted visuals for critical damage hit
-Fixed issues with convertor passive not triggering save
-Cursor can no longer leave the screen
-Can switch monitor that the game shows up on in settings now
-Fixed issues with the Accelerator convertor
-Some performance optimization

Thanks again everyone, cheers!
Engineered to Purpose Team

notes.title: Important Update: No Early Access
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

While our intention was to release in Early Access, we have ended up going for full launch (its complicated), and so we need anyone buying the game to know: 

This game is a work in progress, NOT a finished game. We think that the current state of the game is polished enough that you should get a lot of value out of it - but there is a lot of planned content that is not in place yet, and we want you to be able to make an informed decision when buying the game.

As of launch, half of the game is basically done. The story campaign and levels are in place, and the mechanics are very playable. However two more worlds and the conclusion of our story, new components to build with, new enemy types, and new game modes for post-story replayablity are all coming soon!

We are committed as a dev team to completing this project with as much involvement of players as possible in the design. We'll be updating the Steam page as well to let those who are buying the game know what the current state of the game is.

We'll be looking to release a loose roadmap of our intended plan going forward soon. If you want to stay more directly in the loop with development please join our discord, we'd love to see you there:
https://discord.gg/NBWt438uJH


Apologies if this causes any issues for anyone - do let us know if so, happy to discuss with anyone who has any concerns.

Thanks again all!
Engineered to Purpose Team

notes.title: Release Date Rescheduled to March 26th
notes.notes:
Hey folks, 

Due to some technical issues we're going to have to push the release of Engineered to Purpose by two weeks to March 26th.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43151476/05fd1ab50fe88fdd743fd909ea5e81140ebfe76e.png

We've been working really hard to try to get the game ready but without warning a few days before release we ran into some significant technical issues.

We've added a lot of new stuff to the game for launch, and ran into problems when it came time to put it all together. We don't want to ask you to pay money for something that isn't fully stable, so we have no choice but delaying the launch.

We'll keep you updated on whether anything changes. If you'd like to help us do some playtesting for figuring out the stability - let us know - that would be really helpful to us and much appreciated.

Thanks again everyone for the interest in the game - apologies again for the delay but we just want to make sure we're giving you something that we think you'll enjoy!

-Engineered to Purpose team
